title: Smartitrion-Q Laser Hair Removal, Dubai
desc: The Smartitrion-Q laser at Skin & Laser Dubai: high, consistent power for large areas and PTP mode for more comfortable laser hair removal.
answer: Smartitrion-Q is one of the two laser platforms we use for laser hair removal at Skin & Laser, alongside our diode laser. It delivers high, consistent power across large areas, and its PTP mode splits each pulse to make treatment more comfortable.
body:
## Why we use Smartitrion-Q

Large areas such as legs and back need steady, even energy across every pulse. Smartitrion-Q is designed for that, which helps keep results consistent from one area to the next.

## A more comfortable session

In PTP mode, energy is delivered in a split pulse rather than a single burst, which many patients find gentler, especially on sensitive areas.

## Smartitrion-Q or diode?

Your doctor chooses between Smartitrion-Q and our [diode laser](/blog/diode-laser-hair-removal-dubai/) according to your skin type, hair colour and the area being treated.
faq: Most patients find it comfortable, especially in PTP mode.
Can Smartitrion-Q treat all skin types?
Your doctor confirms suitability for your skin type at the consultation.
